condition: native M. tuberculosis H37Rv nanocompartments and recombinant WT Enc-DyP system expressed in E. coli; DyP-containing
method: TEM; mass spectrometry; cryo-EM; X-ray crystallography
source:
Lien et al. 2021; PDB 8PYS (Willmore & Woodward, 
to be published); Cuthbert et al. 2024
notes: Biologically relevant native DyP-loaded state. DyP-containing nanocompartments were experimentally demonstrated after recombinant expression of the native Enc-DyP system and in M. tuberculosis H37Rv by Lien et al. 2021; native purified particles contained Enc and DyP by mass spectrometry and were approximately 25 nm by TEM. 8PYS provides a 2.7 Å cryo-EM structure of the 60-subunit icosahedral shell prepared in a DyP-loaded context, although DyP was not resolved in the deposited shell model. 9BKX provides a 3.15 Å X-ray structure of the recombinant Mtb Enc-DyP complex with a 60-subunit shell; the compact DyP domain was not resolved, while DyP targeting-peptide density was observed on the shell interior. T=1 is assigned from the experimentally established 60-subunit icosahedral architecture. The 25 nm shell diameter is retained from the Lien et al. 2021 TEM state; 9BKX reports an approximately 24 nm shell. Tagged/recombinant structural constructs are treated as supporting structures of the same biological assembly rather than separate assemblies.
